title: Dinah and the Shechemites

questions.question: Who violated Jacob's daughter Dinah?
questions.explanation: Genesis 34:2 (ESV): "And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her, he seized her and lay with her and humiliated her."

questions.question: What did Shechem ask of Jacob?
questions.explanation: Genesis 34:8: Hamor spoke with them, saying his son Shechem longed for Dinah and asked for her as his wife.

questions.question: Who killed the men of Shechem?
questions.explanation: Genesis 34:25: Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brothers, took their swords and attacked the city.

questions.question: What did Jacob fear after the attack on Shechem?
questions.explanation: Genesis 34:30: Jacob feared the Canaanites and Perizzites would gather against him and attack.

questions.question: Did Shechem love Dinah?
questions.explanation: Genesis 34:3: "His soul was drawn to Dinah...he loved the young woman and spoke tenderly to her."

questions.question: What condition did Jacob's sons set for allowing intermarriage?
questions.explanation: Genesis 34:15: They would agree only if every male among the Shechemites was circumcised.

questions.question: When did Simeon and Levi attack the city?
options: On the third day when the men were sore
questions.correctAnswer: On the third day when the men were sore
questions.explanation: Genesis 34:25: On the third day after circumcision, when the men were still in pain, they attacked.

questions.question: What did Jacob's sons do after killing the men?
questions.explanation: Genesis 34:27-29: The sons of Jacob plundered the city, taking flocks, herds, donkeys, wealth, women, and children.

questions.question: Who was Hamor?
questions.explanation: Genesis 34:2: Shechem was the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land.

questions.question: Were Jacob's sons honest in their demand for circumcision?
questions.explanation: Genesis 34:13: "The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and his father Hamor deceitfully."

questions.question: What did Hamor propose to Jacob's family besides the marriage?
questions.explanation: Genesis 34:9-10: Hamor proposed mutual intermarriage, dwelling together, trading, and acquiring property.

questions.question: How did Simeon and Levi justify their actions?
options: Should Dinah be treated like a prostitute?
questions.correctAnswer: Should Dinah be treated like a prostitute?
questions.explanation: Genesis 34:31: "But they said, 'Should he treat our sister like a prostitute?'"

questions.question: Where did the Shechemites agree to be circumcised?
options: At the gate of the city
questions.correctAnswer: At the gate of the city
questions.explanation: Genesis 34:20: Hamor and Shechem went to the gate of their city and spoke to the men.

questions.question: What argument did Hamor use to convince the Shechemites?
questions.explanation: Genesis 34:23: "Will not their livestock, their property, and all their beasts be ours?"

questions.question: What was Dinah doing when Shechem first saw her?
options: Going out to see the women of the land
questions.correctAnswer: Going out to see the women of the land
questions.explanation: Genesis 34:1: "Now Dinah the daughter of Leah went out to see the women of the land."

key_verse_text: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, 'You have brought trouble on me by making me stink to the inhabitants of the land.'
